text:
I think folks are going to be stunned by how quickly Grok starts generating massive revenue for SpaceX.

Grok Bot is easily one of the most useful (and addicting) AI products out there.

It’s very Apple-like in that “it just works”. And the UI/UX is easily the best out of any other digital AI product, which makes it dead simple to interface with.

Grok 4.6 in Grok Build is legitimately great. It’s just as good as GPT/Claude in most use cases, but far faster and cheaper.

Pair this with the massive growth in compute SpaceX will experience in the coming months, and you’ve got a recipe for a vertically integrated token-generating behemoth.
